summary: Banco Santander filed a 6-K reporting progress under its board-approved share buyback programme, disclosing own-share purchases executed 24-30 September 2026. Cumulative cash deployed reached EUR 915,938,461, about 50.2% of the programme's maximum investment amount, across venues XMAD, CEUX, TQEX and AQEU, at weighted average prices near EUR 12.41-12.61. The bank said purchases equal roughly 18.4% of shares outstanding as of 2021. No premium, advisor, close date or regulatory clock applies; the buyback is the special-situation event. Watch execution pace, remaining authorization and daily volume limits.
